_spec.purpose: Visual variety engine, ported from the upstream publication. The art-direction pass MUST read this before choosing a look and MUST append after delivery. Divergence rules are HARD: hero_structure must differ from the last 4 entries; atmosphere from the last 3; palette_family from the last 3; continuity_device from the last 2; camera_language from the last 2. The CAST is exempt and is meant to repeat; freshness comes from staging.

entries.hero_structure: exterior night street in one-point recession, the pair small on the road, the Institution a cold monolith at the vanishing point, resolving to two stacked federal records
entries.atmosphere: night exterior, rationed practical light: warm shop windows behind, cold ambient on the road, nothing registered on the monolith
entries.continuity_device: camera:one unbroken push down the street that STOPS on the document

entries.hero_structure: a flat machine FACE parallel to camera, full bleed: four tiled steps to a lit intake slot upper left, an odometer boss at centre, a panel painted shut on the right flank, one working chute and one plated dead chute at the lower right frame edge
entries.atmosphere: ONE registered practical over the intake and nothing else; every other surface falls to a crushed floor
entries.continuity_device: edge-tease:the plated dead chute sits at the lower right frame edge from second five and does nothing for thirty-eight seconds, so S15 reverses an ABSENCE rather than introducing an object
entries.set: CountRoomBG, the first set built from the story rather than shopped off the ported shelf
